question: What should come in the place of blank number 4?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Individuals**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage states that governments, organisations, and (4)__________ must work together to overcome obstacles in sustainable agriculture.
 
• The most logical word here is "**Individuals**", since collaboration requires active participation from people alongside institutions.&l
